about: REAL staging capture, 3 Nov 2026 (data of the 2 Nov 2026 session and the filings in the warehouse that night): the Research Copilot W1 answers built by this branch's backend/services/copilot_visual, copied to a scratch path inside nivesh-staging-app-backend and run in-process against the real staging DaaS and NIDP warehouse, read-only, no restart. Plain keys: every read through the live DaaS as deployed (the cash-flow route and the new balance-sheet columns are not live there yet, so company_risks shows them as not served). ':route_sql': financials and cash flow answered by this branch's new DaaS route SQL, run read-only on the warehouse via nidp-psql (real rows; the route goes live only after a daas-api restart). ':production': the same real rows with the TrueData-fillable balance-sheet columns set to null and no cash-flow rows, the shape production has (no TrueData job there; owner 3 Nov 2026). Every other read live.

blocks.text: Our data has 12 quarters of shareholding for ICICIBANK (Dec 23 to Sep 26).

For Sep 26, NSE's filing puts ICICIBANK's FII holding at 50.44% and screener.in at 34.68%: the two sources define it differently for this company. The series uses screener.in, which carries the earlier quarters, and no change is computed across the two sources.

Unusually large one-quarter changes for ICICIBANK: FIIs −9.39 pp (Dec 25 to Mar 26); DIIs −6.80 pp (Dec 25 to Mar 26). A move of more than 5 points can be real, or a change in how the source classifies holders; check the company's shareholding filings for those quarters.
NSE's filing carries a pledge figure for ICICIBANK (Jun 26) that does not agree with the promoter holding (or no promoter group is reported), so it is not shown.
